title.narrative: Malaria - Angola (01-Jul-2016-30-Jun-2018)

description.narrative: Angola, Malaria, Ministry of Health of the Republic of Angola (MOH)This program has the following goals: Reduce by 60% the morbidity and mortality of malaria in the country by 2020 compared to baseline in 2014. The objectives of this program are: By 2020, strengthen the epidemiology surveillance system, monitoring and evaluation and operational research;. By 2020, strengthen the management, technical and institutional capacities of the National Malaria Control Program (NMCP) at all levels, to enable efficient and sustainable implementation of the planned activities of the NMCP.. By the end of 2020, 100% of malaria cases testing positive are treated according to the national guidelines, at all levels of the national health pyramid, including at community level;. By the end of 2020, 100% of suspected malaria cases at health facility, private pharmacies and community levels are tested before receiving treatment;. By the end of 2020, at least 80% of the target population uses an adequate preventive measure;. By the end of 2020, ensure that the Angolan population uses at least 80% of the planned malaria control interventions;

title.narrative: Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for AGO-M-MOHP02
Proportion of confirmed malaria cases that received first-line antimalarial treatment in the community
Number of long-lasting insecticidal nets distributed to targeted risk groups through continuous distribution
Proportion of suspected malaria cases that receive a parasitological test in the community
Number of long-lasting insecticidal nets distributed to at-risk populations through mass campaigns
CM-other 1: Proportion of health facilities without stock-outs of key commodities (RDTs) during the reporting period
CM-other 2: Proportion of health facilities without stock-outs of key commodities (ACTs) during the reporting period
Proportion of confirmed malaria cases that received first-line antimalarial treatment at public sector health facilities
Proportion of suspected malaria cases that receive a parasitological test at public sector health facilities
Percentage of HMIS or other routine reporting units submitting timely reports according to national guidelines
Outcome indicators targets and results for AGO-M-MOHP02
Proportion of households with at least one insecticide-treated net for every two people
Proportion of children under five years old who slept under an insecticide-treated net the previous night
Proportion of pregnant women who slept under an insecticide-treated net the previous night
Proportion of households with at least one insecticide-treated net
Impact indicators targets and results for AGO-M-MOHP02
In-patient malaria deaths: rate per 100,000 persons per year
Malaria test positivity rate
Reported malaria cases (presumed and confirmed)
